limitations: Selected independent review only: 134/135/138/139/140/141 pixels actually viewed; 136/137 pixels not viewed. Author visual_reviewed fields do not substitute independent inspection.

Original appearance proposals do not establish canonical ages, unconfirmed genders, diagnoses, injuries or family outcomes. Front/back pairs depict a single actor, not two simultaneously present people.
No implicit consent, custody transfer, payment, care handoff, migration, political endorsement, story resolution or runtime integration follows from a static board.
Native pixel grid, limited palette, sprite anchors, collision, animation and in-game fidelity unverified. Visible face/cloth detail is finer than a literal 40-pixel sprite; all remain concept drafts.

findings.finding: 三行六姿对应司诺、伊榕、穆柯三个身体，正背发型衣装可对应。伊榕成年母亲身份/穆柯兄弟身份符合来源，银发老年外观仍只是提案，不能反推死者年龄。每人自持纪念物，无死者身体、复活、强共仪、交接或和解；穆柯所持棕色浅器轮廓更像普通碗，未清楚辨出未点燃灯的灯嘴/灯芯，须在正式道具稿区分。两条白布各自持有不证明共用物权。
三行六姿可区分科纳/奇恩/奈汀：闭包、闭箱、闭册。外貌成年男性；科纳兄长关系有源，其他具体年龄与发式只作提案。科纳斜挎包在两视图都落画面右侧，按正背朝向其解剖挂侧不一致；奈汀腰袋也需统一。未画妹妹代签、货物实交、过关许可、付款或赞助免责，服装轮廓略偏近现代裁剪且不是原生像素格。

unviewed_source_notes.note: 仅读来源与提示：齐勒导者、布娅付费访客分人，家属未出场，退款或更正不是既成结局；未核实际像素。
仅读来源与提示：泊恩旧料回收、萝铎驿主分人；样件不证明年代，钥/勺不证明信仰、转货或旅客授权；未核实际像素。

identity_boundaries.ena: MAE-S03-NPC Coldwindow reception coordinator is distinct from NPC-N-ENA, Nara’s wife in N2. No visual comparison to earlier N2 Ena board claimed.
identity_boundaries.kaem: MAE-NPC-KAEM explicitly reuses N10 NPC-N-KAEM identity. Neither batch35 nor batch36 adds a Kaem coverage ID or a Kaem character row.
identity_boundaries.missing_relatives: No missing-relative outcome may be inferred. Known deceased person in ALD funeral is offscreen; Ouran daughter and Buya relatives are offscreen, not assigned death/rescue states.
